extracted.name: Red velvet cupcakes
extracted.description: Great recipe for Red velvet cupcakes.
ingredient_lines: 1 teaspoon Red food coloring, or more if needed
4 oz (115 g) Cream cheese, room temperature
instruction_lines: Sift and mix, then set aside: 1¼ cups (155g) all-purpose flour 1½ tablespoons (12g) Cocoa powder 1/2 teaspoon Baking soda 1/2 teaspoon Salt
MIX 1/4 cup (60g) butter, room temperature 3/4 cup (150g) Sugar
Add one at a time: 1 Egg 1/2 cup (110g) Vegetable oil
Add together: 1/2 teaspoon White Vinegar 1 teaspoons Vanilla extract (120ml) buttermilk, room temperature
Add gradually flour mixture and 1 teaspoon Red food coloring, or more if needed
For frosting beat cream cheese and butter on high speed until and creamy and smooth, about 4-5 minutes. Gradually add powdered sugar and beat until smooth. Add vanilla extract and beat until smooth.
